SciCode: A Research Coding Benchmark Curated by Scientists · documents: The v1 paper distinguishes numerical input/output tests from domain-specific tests, for which scientists check whether solutions reproduce published results or match analytical solutions from theoretical models.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.scicode.paper.numerical-and-scientific-tests

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • This describes the benchmark construction process, not a new independent audit of every test or proof that passing code is scientifically correct beyond the specified checks.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SciCode: A Research Coding Benchmark Curated by Scientists · documents: The v1 paper describes SciCode as scientific coding tasks mainly drawn from scientists’ everyday research scripts, organized into main problems with smaller subproblems and explicit input/output docstrings.

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The authors’ claim of limited exposure in model training data is not independent evidence of no contamination or no related solutions online. The creator FAQ acknowledges that underlying published scientific results can be publicly accessible.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SciCode: A Research Coding Benchmark Curated by Scientists · documents: The v1 paper reports three revision stages: at least two in-domain scientists cross-check the question, solution and domain tests; an out-of-domain scientist reviews clarity and sufficient information; then GPT-4 solutions undergo scientist error analysis and possible test or workflow revision.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.scicode.paper.three-stage-validation.binding-correction-v1

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The creator FAQ explicitly says that human reviewers do not all independently write and execute complete solutions; GPT-4 performs reproduction tasks followed by human error analysis. No stronger independent human replication claim is made.
